sections.section_title: FLASH PCROP area A start address register (FLASH_PCROP1ASR)
sections.text_helper: Section 4.7.7 "FLASH PCROP area A start address register (FLASH_PCROP1ASR)" in chapter 4 (Embedded flash memory (FLASH)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 85.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x024
Reset value: 0b0000 0000 0000 0000 0000 000X XXXX XXXX (The option bits are loaded
with values from flash memory at power-on reset release.)
Access: no wait state when no flash memory operation is on going, word, half-word access
Bits 31:9 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 8:0 PCROP1A_STRT[8:0]: PCROP1A area start offset
Contains the offset of the first subpage of the PCROP1A area.
Note: The number of effective bits depends on the size of the flash memory in the device.

semantic.reset_note: The option bits are loaded with values from flash memory at power-on reset release.
